title: 让 AI 真正进入企业经营
copy: 从战略判断，到场景设计，再到技术落地。找到值得做的 AI，一起把它做出来。

title: 工具很多，落地需要方向
copy:
方向不清：不知道什么值得投入
流程未通：Demo 难以进入真实工作
价值难验：缺少基线与验收标准
visual: An editorial cutaway of three separate business islands, with carefully modeled document piles, disconnected workflow tiles, and a metric panel with empty placeholders, connected at center by a single clear luminous wing-shaped bridge. Communicate fragmentation becoming direction. No fake data.

title: 连接业务与 AI 的落地伙伴
copy:
咨询顾问 · 看清业务问题
方案设计者 · 连接流程与技术
落地伙伴 · 验证、实施与优化
visual: Three beautifully art-directed translucent workstations, a strategy blueprint desk, solution architecture model, and working business pipeline, connected by one pastel ribbon. Isometric refined physical miniature, visual narrative of roles, not repetitive cards.

title: 先回答三个问题
copy:
做什么：选择高价值业务场景
怎么做：设计流程、数据与技术
怎么落地：明确验收与推广路径
visual: A full-page designed triptych with three dimensional question-mark objects made of blue frosted acrylic, peach ceramic, mint glass. Each object connects to precise small business artifacts, magnifying lens selection, blueprint, finish flag. 3 distinct editorial zones.

title: 从判断到实施，一条完整路径
copy:
AI 战略咨询：诊断与优先级
AI 场景咨询：流程与价值评估
解决方案设计：原型与技术选型
AI 项目落地：集成、培训与优化
visual: A vertical flowing four-stage architectural staircase built of pastel acrylic platforms ascending from diagnosis to a working application, each labeled clearly with full service name; selective soft business diagrams embedded, clean purposeful depth.

title: 业务先行，价值贯穿
copy:
看企业 → 找问题 → 找 AI
算价值 → 做方案 → 做出来
每一步，都保留继续、调整或停止的判断
visual: One elegant continuous looping ribbon path with six clear numbered stations around a center business blueprint, ring-road rather than six uniform cards. Mix miniature office/task/review artifacts and use negative space to show a method. Main label Business first beneath title.

title: 找到你的 AI 切入点
copy:
市场 · 销售 · 客服 · 研发
生产 · 供应链 · 管理 · 决策
围绕真实岗位与任务，评估适用边界
visual: A beautiful radial opportunity atlas with 8 distinct business miniatures around center enterprise hub. Editorial infographic, eight spokes deliberately matched to labels, not an unlabelled generic network. Pink blue mint warm yellow. Each industry business action recognizable.

title: 每一步，都有具体交付
copy:
诊断与场景地图
路线图与实施方案
原型与应用系统
培训与运营机制
visual: A curated overhead flatlay of four premium deliverable artifacts: a fold-out opportunity map, roadmap folio, tablet with illustrative business interface marked 示意, and training handbook; physical paper texture, clipped annotations, pastel tools, bold editorial typography. No illegible fake documents.

title: 让能力落在具体工作里
copy:
知识智能：带来源的知识检索
流程与业务智能：询盘整理、报价草拟
决策智能：指标汇总、异常分析
场景示例，非客户案例
visual: Three purposeful illustrated business scenes on a vertical editorial storyboard: librarian knowledge retrieval with source citation sheets, trade inquiry triage drafting quote with human review, manager reviewing traceable metrics. Last disclaimer prominently legible, no client logos or claimed results.

title: 从一个场景，走向一套能力
copy:
单场景验证 → 能力沉淀
系统连接 → 持续演进
先验证价值，再决定扩大投入
visual: An organic stepped expansion diagram, one small solid blue module becoming a thoughtful cluster of pastel modules then an integrated enterprise capability architecture. Four steps visible and labeled. Realistic physical small-scale architectural model with soft studio light.

title: 选择适合当下的合作方式
copy:
AI 顾问：判断方向、审视方案
咨询＋落地：验证问题、推进实施
长期转型伙伴：持续建设、多场景演进
范围、周期与费用，依据项目约定确定
visual: Three editorial columns or vertically staggered pavilions of increasing depth, not pricing cards. Advisory desk, collaborative project room, long-term connected enterprise campus; warm human-scale business collaboration, abstract no realistic faces. No prices or invented durations.

title: 从你的业务出发，一起走到使用
copy:
业务优先 · 技术中立 · 价值可验 · 人机协同
制造看生产与知识，贸易看客户与订单
专业服务看经验与交付，集团看管理与协同
启动前确认数据、权限、接口与负责人
visual: An enterprise adaptation blueprint with four different industry-specific objects around a shared capability layer: factory quality station, trade shipment and quotation, professional-services library, group-management overview; beautiful refined editorial collage. Four principle tags incorporated tastefully.

title: AI，成为企业新的智能能力
copy:
把知识变成可调用的经验
把流程变成可协同的行动
把判断建立在可追溯的信息之上
visual: Hero signature brand wing made from connected translucent business knowledge pages and pathways, taking gentle flight above a grounded minimalist enterprise architecture. Poetic but concrete, confident large typography and luminous wing visual. White background, largest impactful graphic after cover.

title: 从一个真实问题，开始聊起
copy:
你最想改善的业务环节是什么？
一起判断 AI 是否适合，以及如何开始
翼乘咨询 · 咨询 / 方案 / 落地
visual: Warm open invitation scene: two soft translucent dialogue forms meeting at a blue-and-peach consultation table; generous empty clean bottom quarter intentionally reserved for real website CTA and live customer service. Do not draw a fake QR code, no phone/email placeholders, no button baked into image.
